entries.name: Scheduling and realistic capacity
entries.scope: Allocate time using duration, energy, buffers, recovery, and competing responsibilities.
entries.evidence_of_progress: Plans survive normal interruption because they reflect actual capacity.

measurement.minimum_standard: Use at least two independent evidence types, including one behavioral, observer, artifact, objective, or longitudinal indicator; self-report alone is insufficient for score advancement.

entries.name: Project and workflow management
entries.scope: Track scope, ownership, dependencies, risk, decisions, status, and definition of done.
entries.evidence_of_progress: A multi-step project reaches completion with fewer hidden surprises and abandoned threads.

measurement.minimum_standard: Use at least two independent evidence types, including one behavioral, observer, artifact, objective, or longitudinal indicator; self-report alone is insufficient for score advancement.

entries.name: Pacing and sustainable intensity
entries.scope: Match effort to urgency, duration, health, quality, and the importance of the outcome.
entries.evidence_of_progress: Can sprint, maintain, or recover deliberately rather than using one pace for everything.

measurement.minimum_standard: Use at least two independent evidence types, including one behavioral, observer, artifact, objective, or longitudinal indicator; self-report alone is insufficient for score advancement.

entries.name: Follow-through and accountability
entries.scope: Review commitments, communicate risk early, and complete or renegotiate what was promised.
entries.evidence_of_progress: Others and future self can reliably plan around commitments.

measurement.minimum_standard: Use at least two independent evidence types, including one behavioral, observer, artifact, objective, or longitudinal indicator; self-report alone is insufficient for score advancement.

entries.name: Review, measurement, and adaptation
entries.scope: Compare outcomes with plans, identify causes, and revise methods rather than merely judging success or failure.
entries.evidence_of_progress: Regular reviews produce decisions and changed behavior.

measurement.minimum_standard: Use at least two independent evidence types, including one behavioral, observer, artifact, objective, or longitudinal indicator; self-report alone is insufficient for score advancement.

entries.name: Saying no and ending responsibly
entries.scope: Decline low-value demands, release obsolete goals, and close projects or relationships cleanly.
entries.evidence_of_progress: Attention is reclaimed without leaving unnecessary confusion, guilt, or neglected obligations.

measurement.minimum_standard: Use at least two independent evidence types, including one behavioral, observer, artifact, objective, or longitudinal indicator; self-report alone is insufficient for score advancement.
